messages.subject: installation - ggvis 0.2
parts:
Hadley & Winston,

Congrats on the new release - looking forward to getting stuck-in!

I'm getting a weird install error, here's the operative bit:

Quitting from lines 76-84 (axes-legends.Rmd) 
Error: processing vignette 'axes-legends.Rmd' failed with diagnostics:
no applicable method for 'wrap' applied to an object of class "showUrl"

FWIW, shiny and dplyr installed OK. All the gory details at end.

Is there a package I'm missing?

Thanks,

Ian

messages.subject: Re: installation - ggvis 0.2
parts:
My guess is that this has something to do with knitr and/or rmarkdown - the vignettes may require the latest development version of those packages.
  install_github(c("yihui/knitr", "rstudio/rmarkdown"))

Or of course you can take Hadley's suggestion and skip the vignettes.

-Winston
